data_quality.included: Main painted hull and tyre silhouette only. Excludes mirrors, bumpers protrusions, spoiler and tiny underbody detail. Manual trace fills arches where tyres occupy the side projection; no ground shadow.
data_quality.anchor_caveat: Registration forces axle anchors to agree. Only independent calibration or held-out points can verify axle placement.
